title: Bulk AD User Creation
eyebrow: Automating User Provisioning in Active Directory
subtitle: A PowerShell workflow for creating multiple accounts from a CSV source.
summary: User onboarding often requires creating multiple Active Directory accounts within a short period. Performing this task manually increases the risk of configuration errors and consumes valuable administrative time.
prompt: Open this page to present the bulk provisioning workflow, the key benefits, and the sample PowerShell automation used to create AD users from CSV input.

blocks.title: What It Does
blocks.text: This automation reads user data from a CSV file, checks whether the account already exists, creates the account when needed, assigns a password, and writes audit-friendly log entries.

blocks.title: Sample Script
blocks.code:
Import-Module ActiveDirectory

$CsvPath = ".\\Users.csv"
$LogFile = ".\\ADUserCreation.log"

$Users = Import-Csv $CsvPath

foreach ($User in $Users)
{
    try
    {
        $ExistingUser = Get-ADUser `
            -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$($User.SamAccountName)'" `
            -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

        if (!$ExistingUser)
        {
            $Password = ConvertTo-SecureString `
                "Welcome@123" `
                -AsPlainText `
                -Force

            New-ADUser `
                -Name "$($User.FirstName) $($User.LastName)" `
                -GivenName $User.FirstName `
                -Surname $User.LastName `
                -SamAccountName $User.SamAccountName `
                -UserPrincipalName "$($User.SamAccountName)@company.com" `
                -Department $User.Department `
                -Path "OU=Employees,DC=Company,DC=Com" `
                -Enabled $true `
                -AccountPassword $Password `
                -ChangePasswordAtLogon $true

            Add-Content $LogFile "$(Get-Date) - Created $($User.SamAccountName)"
        }
        else
        {
            Add-Content $LogFile "$(Get-Date) - User already exists"
        }
    }
    catch
    {
        Add-Content $LogFile "$(Get-Date) - Error: $_"
    }
}
